notable_absence.finding: Step 9 ('(Optional) To add more words to the wordlist, repeat the previous steps') is the third occurrence in this batch of the same unmodelable one-to-many pattern (after the exception tokenizer's exception patterns and the date/time parser's layouts) - a single wordlist holds an open-ended, user-repeated set of words, and the registry has no predicate for that cardinality.

cross_component_finding: Confirms and generalizes create-custom-token-filter.json's finding from the opposite direction: that page found four SPECIFIC token filter subtypes (dict_compound/elision/keyword_marker/stop_tokens) each composed with a wordlist; this page states the relation once, generally, at the search:token-filter level ('use it with a custom token filter', with no subtype named) - so the corpus now has the same fact asserted at two different granularities from two different pages, which is expected and desired (the general statement here, the specific mechanism-level statements there) rather than a conflict to resolve.
cross_product_finding: No measured Capella twin for this page; not among the eight filename-identical pairs this round's dispatch flagged, and no Capella-side create-custom-wordlist equivalent has been read in this round, so no comparison is forced.
